title: Patient-specific rubric-based evaluation of large language models across longitudinal cancer care
abstract: arXiv:2610.35847v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) show promise in specialty medicine, yet existing evaluations largely focus on isolated clinical encounters rather than tracking how clinical responsibilities evolve across a longitudinal care pathway. Here we introduce NPC-RubricBench, a phase-aware benchmark for evaluating multistage clinical reasoning across the cancer care continuum, using nasopharyngeal carcinoma as a defined disease context. Curated from longitudinal records of 405 patients across two cancer centers, the benchmark comprises 941 patient-phase units across six sequential care phases and 17,688 patient-specific atomic criteria spanning five evaluation dimensions, with each assessment strictly restricted to decision-time clinical evidence. Evaluating 30 general-purpose and medical LLMs revealed that strong diagnostic performance does not carry over to downstream care. translated_title: 基于患者特异性量规的大语言模型在纵向癌症诊疗全程中的评估
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）在专科医学领域展现出潜力，但现有的评估主要聚焦于孤立的临床就诊场景，而非追踪临床职责在纵向诊疗路径中的动态演变。本文提出了NPC-RubricBench，这是一个阶段感知型基准，用于评估癌症诊疗全程中的多阶段临床推理能力，并以鼻咽癌作为明确限定的疾病场景。该基准精选自两家癌症中心405名患者的纵向诊疗记录，涵盖六个连续诊疗阶段的941个患者-阶段单元，以及横跨五个评估维度的17,688条患者特异性原子化评估标准，且每次评估严格限定于决策时刻可获得的临床证据。对30个通用型和医学大语言模型的评估表明，强大的诊断能力并不能延续到下游的诊疗环节。我们对30个通用型和医学大语言模型进行了评估，结果显示高诊断性能……
tldr: 该研究提出了NPC-RubricBench——首个基于405名鼻咽癌患者纵向记录构建、覆盖六个诊疗阶段和17,688条患者特异性评估标准的阶段性临床推理基准，并揭示了大语言模型的诊断能力无法迁移至下游癌症诊疗环节的关键局限。
en_tdlr: The study introduces NPC-RubricBench, a phase-aware benchmark built from longitudinal records of 405 nasopharyngeal carcinoma patients spanning six care phases and 17,688 patient-specific atomic criteria, revealing that strong diagnostic performance of LLMs does not transfer to downstream cancer care.
